claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Fluspirilene, a diphenylbutylpiperidine, kills cells at 2.5 uM primarily through potent voltage-gated calcium channel blockade (and possibly CDK2 inhibition), a class effect shared with other diphenylbutylpiperidine antipsychotics rather than through dopamine receptor antagonism.
